# Codex Studio 0.1.18
## A more immersive Studio
- Larger Canvas artwork, wallpaper-derived ambient color, glass controls, and a selection inspector on wider windows. - Platform shortcuts in Explore, clearer navigation, and a larger bottom-anchored preview. - Settings organized into General, Connection, Library, and Recovery. - Tighter DockDoor artwork for a more consistent icon footprint.
## Reliability and maintainability
- Separate catalog, library, navigation, editor, and runtime responsibilities; smaller editor and Settings components. - Catalog refreshes preserve edits to the selected theme. - Bounded script timeouts and output collection prevent inherited pipes or ignored termination from holding an operation open indefinitely. - Runtime 1.9.2 reconciles completed operations after renderer setup and retries status delivery. - Runtime version changes refresh the build cache automatically. - Local Apple wallpaper packs remain available offline.

# Codex Studio 0.1.17
- New rounded glass app icon with layered artwork and a luminous studio sparkle. - Existing Codex Studio pins in DockDoor Pro receive a content-versioned custom-icon path when Studio launches after updating, avoiding reuse of the previous image URL. - Preserves unrelated DockDoor pins, profile order, settings, and the separate themed Codex launcher icon. - Build staging now detects changed app-icon bytes instead of silently reusing an older local asset cache.
If DockDoor Pro retains an in-memory image until relaunch, quit and reopen DockDoor Pro once. The app does not forcibly restart DockDoor or clear its settings.

# Codex Studio 0.1.16
## Immersive studio redesign
- Larger artwork previews with wallpaper-derived ambient glow across Canvas and Explore. - Refined glass controls, a cleaner sidebar, and a bottom-anchored preview and connection area. - Rebuilt gallery and list cards with independently clickable favorites and clearer active-theme indicators. - Dedicated macOS, iOS, and iPadOS browsing with release filters and numeric version ordering. - Full-artwork previews and a redesigned live editor with bounded preview and inspector layouts. - Cached catalog queries, bounded image decoding, and safeguards against overlapping loading, refresh, and apply operations. - Preserves the local Apple wallpaper library and existing favorites.
Validation: 17 automated tests passed, with local interaction checks for favorites, release filtering, search, artwork preview, and editor layout. Other macOS versions were not independently exercised for this release.
